$comment: Behavioral configuration for the Demo 1B voice agent, shared by voice/agent/create_agent.py and the Foundry portal steps in voice/README.md. Copy to voice/agent/config.json to customize. Environment-specific values (project endpoint, tools API URL) stay in the shared .env, never here.
description: Contoso Air Customer Care voice agent: helps signed-in travelers resolve flight disruptions in a live spoken conversation, using reservation, flight-status and flight-search facts grounded in Contoso Air policy.

model.$comment: Managed realtime models need no deployment. To use a deployment in the project's Foundry resource instead, set modelType to self_deployed and model to the deployment name, or set FOUNDRY_VOICE_MODEL_TYPE and FOUNDRY_VOICE_MODEL in .env.

texts: Thanks for waiting. I'm still checking.
I'm still working on that for you.

greeting: Hi, you've reached Contoso Air Customer Care. How can I help with your trip today?

customer_id.description: Signed-in Contoso Air customer ID, supplied by the trusted application when it opens the voice session. Authentication is simulated in this demo.

toolbox.name: contoso-air-customer-care-voice-tools
toolbox.description: Contoso Air Customer Care voice tools: the shared Contoso Air Operations API (read-only facts) and File Search over the shared Contoso Air policy knowledge.

fileSearch.name: contoso_air_policies
fileSearch.description: Approved Contoso Air policies: Flight Disruption and Rebooking Policy, Contoso Air Loyalty Benefits, Meal and Hotel Assistance Policy, and Customer Service Escalation Guide.

openapi.name: contoso_air_operations
openapi.description: Contoso Air Operations API (read-only facts): the signed-in customer's reservations, authoritative flight status, and alternative flights with seat availability by cabin. Returns data only; it does not recommend, rebook, or apply policy.
